description.content:
BarnBridge is a risk tokenization DeFi protocol. This REST API exposes endpoints for querying SMART Yield structured products, SMART Alpha price-volatility pools, SMART Exposure automated-rebalancing tranches, DAO Governance proposals and treasury data, and Yield Farming staking analytics.
